name: Harvard In Tech - Header Pinned While Scrolling
description: The homepage scrolled down to Our chapters. The white header row (wordmark, the six menu items, Subscribe) stays pinned to the top of the screen with a soft shadow beneath it, while the crimson tagline strip that sits above it at the top of the page has scrolled away. The hover only scrolls the section into view; it is how a capture frames a scrolled state, since URL fragments do not scroll.
